local: We lay our future in thy hand;
english: We lay our future in thy hand;

local: Our love and labour we give;
And with neighbours all at our country's call
In peace and friendship we'll live.
english: Our love and labour we give;
And with neighbours all at our country's call
In peace and friendship we'll live.

local: Oh, [[Uganda]]! The land that feeds us,
By sun and fertile soil grown;
For our own dear land, we shall always stand,
english: Oh, [[Uganda]]! The land that feeds us,
